tr.td: Stop reliever-only albuterol and start budesonide-formoterol maintenance-and-reliever therapy at Step 4 (two inhalations twice daily plus one as needed, up to 12 a day), with a spacer and inhaler-technique teaching

Written asthma action plan with symptom and peak-flow zones (green 80 percent or more of personal best, yellow 50 to 79 percent, red below 50 percent), reviewed at every visit and after every exacerbation
Pulmonology referral to confirm the diagnosis, assess type 2 inflammation, and advise on exercise-induced symptoms, allergen measures, and treatment step

Asthma Control Test, inhaler technique, adherence, reliever use, triggers, and exacerbation history at every visit; review one to three months after starting controller therapy, then every three to twelve months, and within one week of any exacerbation; spirometry at diagnosis, three to six months after stabilization, then every one to two years

Explain that exercise improves fitness but does not treat airway inflammation; take one reliever inhalation before boxing or rowing; use dust-mite-impermeable bedding covers once sensitization is shown
Yearly influenza vaccine, pneumococcal vaccination for chronic lung disease, and COVID-19 vaccination by CDC guidance
